summary_md: **Deepu K Sasidharan ([@deepu105](https://x.com/deepu105/status/2115087564260479434))** ships **LlamaStash v0.10.0**, a terminal-native local-LLM orchestrator that now runs 20+ tested engines behind one proxy (chat: llama.cpp, vLLM, Strata; image: sd.cpp, ComfyUI; STT: whisper.cpp, Speaches; TTS: Kokoro, Fish Speech, Piper), each with a tested config in RECIPES.md.

referenced_urls.title: LlamaStash — Zero-overhead, terminal-native local-LLM orchestrator. Run any engine, any model via the same proxy.

relevance: One proxy in front of many local inference engines is useful plumbing for agents that need chat, speech and image models locally.

media.description: LlamaStash v0.10.0 card: 20+ tested inference engines behind one proxy, grouped as chat (llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, ...), image (sd.cpp, ComfyUI), STT (whisper.cpp, ...), TTS (Kokoro-FastAPI, Piper, ...) and classifiers, plus 'curl -fsSL https://llamastash.dev/install.sh | sh' and 'llamastash init'.
media.ocr_text: LlamaStash v0.10.0. Now runs 20+ tested inference engines behind one proxy. chat: llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, Strata, Halogen, gufo, CIRU, ds4, Lemonade, FastFlowLM (AMD NPU). image: sd.cpp, ComfyUI, LocalAI, Lemonade. STT: whisper.cpp, Speaches, LocalAI, Lemonade, FastFlowLM. TTS: Kokoro-FastAPI, Fish Speech, Chatterbox, Piper, Speaches, LocalAI, Lemonade. classifiers: LANCET, Kev, Laya (on llama.cpp). $ curl -fsSL https://llamastash.dev/install.sh | sh $ llamastash init — installs llama-server for your hardware, picks a starter model, writes a tuned config. llamastash.dev. every engine has a tested config in RECIPES.md
